notes: Official owner's manual could NOT be read: alfaromeousa.com, mopar.com, manualsfile.com, autouserguide.com returned 403, alfaromeo.ca 404, lab-aftersales.fiat.com 503. All rows third-party. No engine-bay PDC, no relay tables found in any readable source; the existing CUORE engine-bay/rear PDC data is therefore not covered here. Fuse types come from StartMyCar only. Locations come from fuse-box.info text (the page's diagrams were not readable). Sources show only 16 positions, the same as CUORE existing count; a French Fiat service PDF (lab-aftersales.fiat.com/elearn_testreda/949001500.pdf) reportedly has rear PDC tables but was unreadable (503).
